name: Demolition Dynasty
summary: Demolition Dynasty is a physics-based demolition game for mobile. The player runs a demolition company and brings down houses, factories, silos and skyscrapers with cannons and explosives; buildings collapse with real physics when their load-bearing columns are hit. It features 300 jobs across 12 districts, including Old Town, Harbour, Power Plant, Skyscraper District and the Metropolis, with partial demolitions where only marked buildings may fall, timed, economy and sequence jobs, rescues, chain reactions and boss jobs at the end of each district. Between jobs the player upgrades the company in a workshop with 10 weapons (from a bolt gun to a howitzer, wrecking ball and bunker buster), 12 ammo types and 6 explosives, and hires a crew. Jobs take place by day, at sunset, in rain and on night shifts under floodlights.
